info.name: HappyMart API – Phase 2 tests
info.description:
End-to-end API tests for the 5 HappyMart microservices (User, Catalog, Order, Payment, Review).

Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner or Newman:

  newman run HappyMart.postman_collection.json -e HappyMart.local.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra

Prerequisites: all 5 services running, and one Admin, one Staff and one Customer account in UserServiceDB (fill their phone/password in the environment).

item.name: 1. Auth (UserService)
item.description: Logs in the three seeded accounts and stores their JWTs. Fill adminPhone/adminPassword, staffPhone/staffPassword and customerPhone/customerPassword in the environment first.

exec: pm.test("Has at least one category", () => pm.expect(items.length).to.be.above(0));
pm.test("Cart contains the product", () => pm.expect(cart.items.some(i => i.productId == pm.collectionVariables.get("testProductId"))).to.be.true);

item.name: Add to cart again (for cancel test)

exec: pm.test("POS order is paid and completed", () => { pm.expect(o.orderType).to.eql("POS"); pm.expect(o.paymentStatus).to.eql("Paid"); pm.expect(o.orderStatus).to.eql("Completed"); });
pm.test("No shipping fee at the counter", () => pm.expect(o.shippingFee).to.eql(0));

item.name: Stock after online order (-2) and POS sale (-1): 100 → 97

exec: pm.test("Stock decreased by confirmed order and POS sale", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().quantityInStock).to.eql(97));
pm.test("Cash payment is completed immediately", () => pm.expect(p.status).to.eql("Completed"));

item.name: VNPay IPN with fake signature → RspCode 97

request.description: Fires 6 login attempts in the pre-request script, then expects the real request to be rejected with 429 Too Many Requests. Wait 1 minute before running the collection again.

exec: // Burn the 5-requests-per-minute quota of the "auth" policy first.
body: { mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify({ phone: "0000000000", password: "x" }) }
